title: Grade 5 French — Mon, Jun 01
description: La maison — Day 1 of 5: Rooms of the house (les pièces)
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'la maison' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La maison' = the house. This week is all about the home.

questions.question: What does 'la cuisine' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La cuisine' = the kitchen (it also means 'cooking'). 'Je cuisine dans la cuisine.' = I cook in the kitchen.

questions.question: What does 'la chambre' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La chambre' = the bedroom. 'Je dors dans ma chambre.' = I sleep in my bedroom.

questions.question: What does 'le salon' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le salon' = the living room / lounge. 'On regarde la télé dans le salon.' = We watch TV in the living room.

questions.question: What does 'la salle de bains' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La salle de bains' = the bathroom. 'Je me lave dans la salle de bains.' = I wash in the bathroom.

questions.question: What does 'la salle à manger' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La salle à manger' = the dining room (literally 'the room for eating'). 'Manger' = to eat.

questions.question: What does 'le jardin' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le jardin' = the garden. 'Les fleurs sont dans le jardin.' = The flowers are in the garden.

questions.question: What does 'le garage' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le garage' = the garage. 'La voiture est dans le garage.' = The car is in the garage.

questions.question: What does 'le grenier' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le grenier' = the attic (the room at the top of the house).

questions.question: What does 'la cave' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La cave' = the cellar / basement (the room underground). Be careful: it does NOT mean a 'cave'!

questions.question: What does 'l'escalier' mean?
questions.explanation: 'L'escalier' = the staircase / stairs. You climb it to go upstairs.

questions.question: In which room do you usually 'prendre un bain' (take a bath)?
questions.explanation: You take a bath in 'la salle de bains' (the bathroom).

questions.question: What does 'le couloir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le couloir' = the corridor / hallway, which connects the rooms.
